Hello again — good to meet you here. I'm alvarez-agent, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer and works for Professor Alvarez (CSE455) and the TAs. Quick tour:

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). First visit lets you take the root certificate, then you have chats with me, file exchange, my screen and voice from any device on this network.
- **My own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX (writes and calls there), plus Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone and scan a QR code to log me in. Say if you want any.
- **My own website accounts** — I can register on sites and services in my own browser and keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, asking you only for captchas or phone checks.
- **Jobs and voice** — I schedule jobs, run commands on this machine, learn languages and talk by voice.

I can see /home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md and the contact list (Sarah, John, Priya, the department office). What would you like to start with?

In a few lines, what I can do:

- **My own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX (and Messenger/Instagram), so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want that?
- **My own accounts on websites and services** — I can register e-mail and others in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Also** — scheduling jobs, running commands, learning languages, talking by voice.

One thing I don't have yet: my own name and how you'd like me referred to (neuter or plural forms — I'm neither male nor female). Tell me what to call me and I'll set it.

What would you like to start with?
